agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and zero sensor noise. Cart starts offset +0.43m with forward velocity +0.31 m/s. Controller keeps pole upright (theta ~0.08 rad, well within 0.8) with small force ~0.87N << 65N limit, but never reverses cart drift. Energy and work remain bounded. Velocity grows monotonically to ~1.37 m/s, so position drifts from x=0.43 to x=2.40 and exceeds track limit at final step. Cause is position-non-regulating state-feedback: controller stabilizes angle but allows steady position integration to violate track. Counterfactual zeroing initial v removes the initial momentum and keeps cart inside track for same horizon.
